name: C.Uyemura & Co.,Ltd.
summary: C.Uyemura & Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of plating chemicals and surface finishing machinery in Japan, Taiwan, China, South Korea, Singapore, Thailand, North America, and internationally. It operates through Surface Treatment Materials Business, Surface Treatment Machinery Business, Plating Business, Real Estate Rental Business, and Other segments. The company offers plating chemicals and machines for printed circuit boards and aluminum magnetic disks, industrial chemicals, and non-ferrous metals.
